r04.
Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used. Webhook workers consume from an in-process buffered Go channel, `asyncPostQueue`, declared with capacity 128 at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`; four workers drain it at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54`, and `PostAsync` enqueues at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:182-195`.
